162:def _ensure_padded_year(ref_date: str) -> str:
163:    # Reference dates without a padded year (e.g. since 1-1-1 or since 2-3-4)
164:    # are ambiguous (is it YMD or DMY?). This can lead to some very odd
165:    # behaviour e.g. pandas (via dateutil) passes '1-1-1 00:00:0.0' as
166:    # '2001-01-01 00:00:00' (because it assumes a) DMY and b) that year 1 is
167:    # shorthand for 2001 (like 02 would be shorthand for year 2002)).
168:
169:    # Here we ensure that there is always a four-digit year, with the
170:    # assumption being that year comes first if we get something ambiguous.
171:    matches_year = re.match(r".*\d{4}.*", ref_date)
172:    if matches_year:
173:        # all good, return
174:        return ref_date
175:
176:    # No four-digit strings, assume the first digits are the year and pad
177:    # appropriately
178:    matches_start_digits = re.match(r"(\d+)(.*)", ref_date)
179:    if not matches_start_digits:
180:        raise ValueError(f"invalid reference date for time units: {ref_date}")
181:    ref_year, everything_else = (s for s in matches_start_digits.groups())
182:    ref_date_padded = f"{int(ref_year):04d}{everything_else}"
183:
184:    warning_msg = (
185:        f"Ambiguous reference date string: {ref_date}. The first value is "
186:        "assumed to be the year hence will be padded with zeros to remove "
187:        f"the ambiguity (the padded reference date string is: {ref_date_padded}). "
188:        "To remove this message, remove the ambiguity by padding your reference "
189:        "date strings with zeros."
190:    )
191:    warnings.warn(warning_msg, SerializationWarning, stacklevel=2)
192:
193:    return ref_date_padded

201:    matches = re.match(r"(.+) since (.+)", units)
202:    if not matches:
203:        raise ValueError(f"invalid time units: {units}")
204:
205:    delta_units, ref_date = (s.strip() for s in matches.groups())
206:    ref_date = _ensure_padded_year(ref_date)
